about: Statement splitting cases shared by the two splitters: apps/workspace/src/sqlSelection.ts (splitStatements, statementAt; test/sql-selection.mjs) and myflames/dbops.py split_statements with myflames/editor_session.py statement_at (test/test_sql_split_twins.py). Statement texts are compared after leading white space and leading line or block comments (not /*! or /*M! executable comments) are removed, since the two attribute a comment after a delimiter to different statements. In cursor cases | marks the caret and index is the statement Run sends. backslash false reads strings as under NO_BACKSLASH_ESCAPES.

statements.sql:
SELECT 1 /* a; b */ + 2; SELECT 3 -- c; d
; SELECT 4 # e; f
SELECT 'a\'; INSERT INTO t VALUES (1); SELECT 'c';

/*M!100000 SELECT 1 */;
/*!50001 CREATE VIEW v AS SELECT 1 */;

texts:
CREATE PROCEDURE p()
BEGIN
  SELECT 'a;b'; SELECT 2;
END

cursors.sql: SELECT 'a\'; INSERT INTO t VALUES (1)|; SELECT 'c';
SELECT 'a\'; INSERT INTO t VALUES (1)|; SELECT 'c';
